title: Rust CLI Tool README Generation
prompt: Generate a production-ready README for a Rust CLI tool named 'ripx' that rapidly searches compressed archives. Include Shields.io badges, installation via cargo and homebrew, options table, and test commands.

expected_elements.title_and_hook: # ripx followed by a punchy value proposition hook.
expected_elements.cli_flags_table: Markdown table with columns Flag, Short, Type, Default, Description.

title: Fullstack Next.js + PostgreSQL App README
prompt: Generate a README for a collaborative whiteboard application built with Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. Include an architecture diagram in Mermaid, prerequisites with minimum versions, an environment variables table, and local development steps.

expected_elements.mermaid_diagram: flowchart TD illustrating Client, Next.js Frontend, Backend API, PostgreSQL database, and Redis cache.
expected_elements.env_variables_table: Markdown table with DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL with types, defaults, and required flags.
expected_elements.local_dev_workflow: pnpm install, cp .env.example .env.local, pnpm db:push, pnpm dev.

title: Python Data Validation Library README
prompt: Write a PyPI library README for 'schemaval', a type-safe schema validator for Python. Include a 5-minute quickstart with type annotations, installation via pip and poetry, API highlights, and testing with pytest.

expected_elements.quickstart_code: Python code block demonstrating imports, schema definition, and validation call.
expected_elements.installation: pip install schemaval or poetry add schemaval

title: Google Antigravity Agent Skill README
prompt: Generate a README for an Antigravity Agent Skill named 'sql-optimizer'. Include agent trigger guidelines (when to activate and when NOT to activate), directory layout tree, bundled scripts table, and validation instructions.

expected_elements.trigger_guidelines: Explicit bulleted list of user queries that should activate the skill, plus negative boundaries.
expected_elements.directory_tree: Annotated ASCII tree showing SKILL.md, evals/, references/, and scripts/.
expected_elements.bundled_scripts_table: Table listing scripts, their purpose, and example CLI invocations.

title: Audit and Remediate a Flawed Legacy README
prompt: Audit an existing legacy README that contains unreplaced [TODO] strings, no prerequisites, no badges, missing environment variable documentation, and vague test instructions. Output the score breakdown (0-100) and specific remediation action items.

expected_elements.placeholder_penalty: Flags unreplaced [TODO] placeholder tokens with gate failure or penalty.
expected_elements.checklist_breakdown: Displays PASS/WARN/FAIL status across all 12 rubric items.
expected_elements.actionable_remediation: Numbered list of concrete steps: add value hook, add prerequisites with versions, document .env variables, add copy-pasteable test commands.
